title: Past the Sensors
description: Past the catalyst the sculk thins and the silence
changes key, from the silence of a place that hears to
the silence of a place that waits. A blue torch burns
at the last junction, planted by nobody the city ever
The signal is next. Something under the city has been
talking for a long time in a language of pulses, and
the torch at the junction is not decoration: it is
Six stations, the same six, in blue light.
The wool bridge behind you stays down. Courtesy
extended is courtesy returned, even by a city.
